items.title: George "Pops" Foster Interview, 1958-08-24
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] And Pox was born in 1892. [INTERVIEWEE] Yes. My mother on this side. My father is her mother.

ctx.x: That's my mother, my father and her mother.
Yes. My mother on this side. My father is her mother. I think Jonathan says he's in May 2 or April, isn't he?
